findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Ensure that all food handlers obtain their food handler certifications within 30 days of hire. 

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: Observed no quat test strips available during the inspection. Test strips provided by the inspector. Ensure additional test strips are purchased. 
A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text: 6-202.14  (C)  Both the men's and women's restroom does not have a tight-fitting and self-closing door. All toilet rooms located within a food establishment must be enclosed with a tight-fitting and self-closing door. Reference 6-202.14.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
REPEAT> Observed the chest freezer to have an accumulation of ice. Defrost the freezer.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
REPEAT> No test strips are available today. Bartender reports she uses the SaniTabs as her sanitizer--make sure to have the appropriate test strips for testing sanitizer concentration.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom drip tray of the pizza oven to be soiled and the bottom of the inside of the microwave to be soiled with food debris. Clean these surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed a hose connected to the back room three compartment sink faucet without a proper back flow preventer installed. Hose was removed. Provide a back flow preventer before re-installing hose.
750-1080 The potable water system shall be installed to preclude the possibility of backflow.  Devices to protect against backflow and back siphonage shall be installed at all fixtures and equipment where an air gap at least twice the diameter of the water inlet is not provided between the water outlet from the fixture and the fixture’s flood-level rim and wherever else backflow or backsiphonage may occur. Install backflow prevention device.
